guide.title: How the provider uses this credential (integration API)
guide.intro: The credential lets the provider's own system (for example, a hotel booking system or a tour operator) update its availability time slots in VITASMARTA automatically, without entering them by hand in the portal. Changes reach Bookings and the Catalog just as if the provider made them in “My offer”. Give the provider the key and these instructions.
guide.authDesc: the key issued here (shown only once). Requires the “Write availability” permission.
guide.idemDesc: a unique identifier (UUID) per request; if the system retries with the same value, the change is not duplicated.
guide.contentIdDesc: the ID of the provider's attraction, activity or event (it appears in the address of its edit page in “My offer”). The credential can only operate on its own provider's content.
guide.fieldVersion: current availability version (optional). If it does not match, the API answers 409 and the system must read again and retry.
guide.fieldReplace: true replaces all the content's time slots with the ones sent; false adds or updates only the ones sent.
guide.fieldState: disponible (available), agotado (sold out) or cerrado (closed). Dates as YYYY-MM-DD and times as HH:MM (Colombia time).

responses.400: missing Idempotency-Key header or invalid body.
responses.403: the key lacks the permission or the content belongs to another provider.
responses.409: the expected version does not match the current one.
responses.429: the credential's per-minute request limit was exceeded.

guide.security: Security: the key is equivalent to a password for the provider's system. If it leaks or is no longer used, revoke it on this screen and issue a new one.
